groom.name: Joel
groom.parents: Mr. Mathew George & Mrs. Annie Mathew
groom.line: Son of grace and laughter, stepping forward with love and devotion.

bride.name: Maria
bride.parents: Mr. Thomas Varghese & Mrs. Elizabeth Thomas
bride.line: Daughter of faith and warmth, embracing a new chapter of togetherness.

verse.text: Grant that we may grow old together.

welcome: Some stories take years to find their way. Ours found its way home.
With joy, Joel & Maria invite you to celebrate their wedding.

lines.ceremonies: Join us as we begin our forever.
lines.rsvp: We’d love to know you’re coming. RSVP here.
lines.closing:
From our first hello to forever.
See you there.

story.quote: Every love story is beautiful, but ours is our favourite.

chapters.title: The First Hello
chapters.text: A friend’s birthday, a crowded room, and one conversation that went on long after the cake was gone.

chapters.title: Coffee, Again
chapters.text: One coffee became a habit. Then a favourite table. Then a standing plan every Saturday.

chapters.title: Meeting the Families
chapters.text: Nervous introductions, too much food, and two families who got along better than we hoped.

chapters.title: Best Friends First
chapters.text: Long drives, longer talks and the easy kind of quiet you only find with your person.

chapters.title: The Question
chapters.text: A sunset, a shaky voice and the quickest yes in history.

chapters.title: Forever Starts Now
chapters.text: And now we’d love for you to be there as we begin the next chapter.

weather.title: Dress for the heat
weather.sub: Hot and humid, even into the evening
weather.text: April is the hottest month of the year. Please choose light, breathable fabrics, keep sunglasses and sunscreen handy, and drink plenty of water through the day. A short afternoon shower is possible too.
